title: Root-normalized finite quotient line realizations
statement: For the uniformizer quotient lines and root limits of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-diagrams], a realization of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-realization] identifies the quotient line with the positive finite Cartier line of [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface]. For a positive ell power N killing the quotient, require that the integral-root-limit map followed by quotient extension, underlying realization and this line isomorphism is exactly projection to the N-th roots followed by the kernel-normalized root-to-finite-line map. The shifted derived line comparison uses the existing exact comparison/single and shift isomorphisms into the positive Tate object of [sk-lem-geo-p1-cohomology].
